name: PR Tour
description: Understand a PR, then tour its diff in the order that explains it. For each PR waiting on you, your agent writes a guide: what, why and the impact, risk and findings, a stop-by-stop tour, and a review you post to GitHub.

cover.alt: A guide's what, why and impact above tour stop 12 of 13: the stop list, the one idea this stop explains, and the diff hunk that shows it

screenshots.alt: Guide overview: what, why and impact, a medium risk callout, findings by severity, the changes by area and the 13-stop tour grid
screenshots.caption: Overview: risk, findings, the changes and the tour

screenshots.alt: Stop 12 of 13: the stop list on the left, the explanation above the AutomationSection.tsx diff, and a major finding with its suggested comment under line 109
screenshots.caption: A tour stop: one idea, the hunks that show it, and findings in place

screenshots.alt: Finish review: a major finding to add or dismiss, two pending comments, the summary, where the review goes, and Post to GitHub
screenshots.caption: Finish review: settle findings, then post one GitHub review

screenshots.alt: PR Tour settings: agent harness, model, auto-generate toggles, teams, team filter, daily limit and extra instructions
screenshots.caption: Settings: pick the agent and model, teams and limits

settings.title: Agent harness
settings.description: The agent CLI that writes guides. It runs in the background with read-only tools, on the account it is signed in with.

settings.title: Model
settings.description: Passed to the agent as its model flag. Leave empty for the agent's default.

settings.title: Make guides when my review is requested
settings.description: In repositories you turned on. Updated after each push by the author.

settings.title: Teams
settings.description: GitHub teams whose review requests appear in Your teams, comma separated (org/team).

settings.title: Make guides for team requests that pass the filter
Team filter: changes files my team owns (CODEOWNERS)
Team filter: at least this many lines changed
Also list my own open PRs
settings.description: Shows Your PRs, so you can see the guide reviewers will get.

settings.title: Daily limit
settings.description: Automatic runs per day across all repositories. Generate by hand always works.

settings.title: Extra instructions
settings.description: Added to the agent's prompt after the built-in instructions.
settings.placeholder: e.g. Call out any change to money movement or KYC.
